prompt: Hono's MIME lookup appends a charset parameter to text types, producing values like 'text/xml; charset=utf-8'. The reverse lookup that turns a MIME type back into a file extension compares the whole string, so a parameterised type never matches and callers silently fall back to a default extension. Fix both halves: make the MIME-to-extension helper ignore anything from the first ';' onwards before matching, and make the static-site generator's extension-map lookup do the same before consulting its map. Do not add a new file.
